title: Security Operations Lead
description:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Engineering Manager (PL1)
Team: Information & Cyber Security, within Platform & Security Engineering
Salary: £70,000 - £87,000 + discretionary bonus
Contract: Permanent
Reporting to: Senior Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

You’ll join the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn’t a silo, so you’ll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As Security Operations Lead, you’ll own and grow the Security Operations function, leading a team across the UK and Australia. You’ll be the senior escalation point for security incidents, a calm and authoritative presence under pressure, and the person who keeps our operational security evolving to meet new threats, including those that come with being an AI-enabled business.

- Lead the team: Build, mentor and manage the performance of a Security Operations team across the UK and Australia, creating an environment of continuous learning, clear ownership and psychological safety

- Evolve incident response: Develop our incident response processes, especially around AI, maintain playbooks and standard operating procedures, and run exercises that build team confidence when it matters most

- Hunt threats: Proactively hunt for threats before they become incidents, and work with penetration testers, red teams and bug bounty programmes to find weaknesses, then partner with security engineering and technology teams to close gaps

- Own detection and tooling: Own our security monitoring and detection capability, including SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence platforms, driving the tooling roadmap, tuning detections to cut noise, and championing automation

- Report on what matters: Define and own Security Operations KPIs and KRIs, and give senior stakeholders clear reporting on the health of the function, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond and coverage trends

- Support compliance and governance: Make sure our security operations posture supports our regulatory and contractual obligations, acting as a key stakeholder in audits, assessments and customer security reviews, and working closely with Legal, Compliance and Privacy

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

- Experience managing and mentoring engineers and/or operations specialists

- Expertise in incident response, with hands-on experience leading major incidents

- Experience in threat intelligence and hunting, proactively seeking threats in complex, cloud-native environments

- A good working understanding of adversarial techniques (MITRE ATT&CK and similar frameworks), and how you keep up to date

- Genuine curiosity about the security risks introduced by AI systems, such as model abuse, prompt injection and data exfiltration

- Familiarity with modern security operations tooling

- Experience automating repeatable processes rather than relying on manual effort

description:

Technical Knowledge

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, People Intelligence

Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. - Keep sensitive people and financial data correct and access-controlled: identity-aware access, authorization enforced in code, and tests that catch regressions before deploy

- Work directly with company leaders and partner teams (People, Finance, IT, and others) to decide what gets built

title: Marketing Lead
description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
You are the PM of marketing. You own the strategy, the key partnerships, and the press, and you keep everything marketing does tied tightly to the product, the business, and the technical teams building it. This is the most generalist role on the team. You set the direction, you connect the dots, and you are just as comfortable writing the narrative as you are running the plan behind it.

What You'll Do

• Own the overall marketing strategy and turn the company roadmap into a story worth telling

• Drive key partnerships that expand our reach, credibility, and distribution

• Own press and media relations, and act as a trusted external voice for Menlo

• Keep marketing aligned with product, business, and engineering, so the message always matches the machine

• Set positioning and messaging for Asimov and the Menlo Platform

• Build and prioritize the marketing roadmap, then decide what ships and what waits

• Plan and run launches that make each milestone land

• Measure what is working, kill what is not, and double down where it counts

• Shape and grow the marketing team over time

What We Look For

• A generalist marketer who has worn many hats and can move between strategy and execution without friction

• A track record of owning marketing strategy and shipping launches that moved the needle

• Real strength in partnerships and press, with the network and instincts to match

• Credibility with engineers and researchers, and the ability to translate their work for the rest of the world

• Comfort being the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone pointed the same way

• A bias to action and genuine comfort in an early-stage, fast-changing environment

• Excellent writing and storytelling

Nice to Have

• A background in deep tech, hardware, robotics, or AI

• An existing press and partnership network you can activate on day one

• Experience building a marketing function from close to zero

• Enough technical fluency to hold your own in a room full of builders

Why Join Menlo
We are a physical AI company building real robots, and marketing sits at the center of the story. You own strategy, partnerships, and press outright, with the mandate to shape the whole function and a direct line to product, research, and leadership, with no layers to fight through. You get to build in public at a company where the work speaks for itself, with the room to shape the function as we grow.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

title: Engineering Manager - Ads
description:
About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.

• Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.

• Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.

• Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.

• Partner with client engineers, data analysts and product on the roadmap, balancing revenue, retention and ad inventory.

• Grow the team's ML depth through hiring, mentorship and career development, and manage performance effectively.

Background & Experience :

• 2+ years of engineering management experience.

• 5+ years as a backend software developer. You're comfortable writing code, discussing trade-offs and taking part in system design.

• Hands-on experience building and running ML systems in production: model serving, real-time decisioning, feature pipelines, and monitoring for model drift and data quality.

• Solid grasp of applied ML for decision-making (bandits, ranking, recommendation or propensity models), deep enough to challenge modelling choices and trade-offs with the team.

• Strong experiment design skills, including statistical rigour and the trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term retention.

• Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback and performance development.

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining ML trade-offs in business terms.

Bonus Points

• Experience in ad tech, ad serving or large-scale experimentation on a large consumer platform.

• Contextual or multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning or uplift modelling in production.

• ML platform tooling: feature stores, model registries and workflow

• User LTV, churn or subscription-propensity modelling.

• Ad standards and integrations: VAST, programmatic demand (SSPs and DSPs), frequency capping.

• Audio or video advertising.

• Scala or another JVM language, and Python for ML work.

title: Product Manager, Evals
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

Evals at Exa

 

The Evals Team sits at the heart of our mission. We train foundational models for search. Our goal is to build systems that can instantly filter the world's knowledge to exactly what you want, no matter how complex your query. Basically, put the web into an extremely powerful database. And to do that well, we need to measure what “good search” actually means. That’s where you come in.

 

As a Product Manager on the Evals team, you will partner with research, product, GTM, and engineering to oversee the quality and completeness of our evaluation data. You will be responsible for ensuring our search models are being evaluated against comprehensive and high-quality datasets, across numerous domains. You’ll manage relationships with external vendors and make key strategic decisions on what data is important for our evals - and acquire it. Your work will play a key role in Exa’s mission of a perfect information society.

 

Who You Are

- Hustler in negotiating, securing, and managing relationships with external vendors

- Care and excellence in writing. At Exa we value human communications free of AI generated text

- High ownership and attention to detail

- Strong numerical literacy and technical background. CS/EE degree, production engineering experience, or equivalent depth earned on the job

 

What You Could Do

- Build specific, localized eval feedback and signal

- Write a manifesto of what perfect search means

- Define metrics and success criteria for our evaluation data suites

- Partner closely with ML researchers, data engineers, infra engineers, and product to shape the data loops that improve our search models

 

Logistics

- Location: This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

- Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

About the Role

You will build and run OpenAI’s trade compliance program across Europe. Your remit spans cross-border shipping routes, partner and supplier arrangements, daily trade operations and compliance oversight for the legal entities involved. You will work with Legal, direct tax and indirect tax teams to design structures that meet trade requirements while improving cost and speed. We are looking for someone who can build from the ground up, make sound business decisions and stay close to execution. You will also help set a new benchmark for how trade compliance programs use AI to improve decisions, strengthen controls and support growth.

In this role, you will:

- Design compliant trading and supply-chain structures with Legal, direct tax and indirect tax teams. Evaluate company, transaction, partner and supplier arrangements to improve cost, speed and operating reliability.

- Build the European trade compliance program and launch cross-border shipping routes. Put customs, import, export, sanctions and cross-border e-commerce requirements into workable processes.

- Own ongoing European import, export and returns operations, including customs warehousing where needed. Manage brokers and service providers, resolve issues and maintain reliable service as volume and complexity grow.

- Set and test compliance policies and controls for each legal entity. Maintain required authorizations, respond to rule changes, prepare for audits, resolve gaps and report risks to leaders.

- Personally manage relationships with customs and other trade authorities. Work with Legal to defend compliance positions and programs, respond to audits and inquiries, and resolve issues.

- Use AI to improve trade analysis, document review and ongoing monitoring. Build and test these processes, retain human review and decision records, and measure gains in accuracy and speed.

- Use shipment, inventory and customs data to investigate problems and compare options. Define the data and systems the program needs, and track whether processes and controls work.

- Bring business, supply chain, Finance, Tax, Legal and technology teams together to turn strategy into clear procedures, training and measurable operating improvements.

title: International Recruiter – European Customer Service Roles – Bengaluru
description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Bengaluru and across India.
Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.
Who we are
BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.
We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.
You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.
Who we're looking for
People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.
We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.
You'll probably fit if:

• You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

• You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.

• You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

• You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

• You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

• You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

• You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

• You want something to try "when you have time".

• You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

• You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.

• Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

• You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

•
Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400-750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.

• You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.

• A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.

• Payment usually comes 1-3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.

•
Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back
Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

• Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.

• Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.

• Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own vendor contracting end to end

- Review, draft, and negotiate a high volume of vendor agreements, including MSAs, order forms, SOWs, SaaS and cloud subscription terms, DPAs, and NDAs.

- Serve as the single point of contact for all vendor contracting matters raised by FinOps, IT, Security, and business owners, from intake through signature, renewals, amendments, disputes, and offboarding. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters.

- Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk.

- Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it.

- Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes.

Build and scale vendor contracting operations

- Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks.

- Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps.

- Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks.

- Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Required

- 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms.

- A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace.

- Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers.

- Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow.

- Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate.

- Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information.

Preferred

- A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree.

- Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side.

- Hands-on experience with Ironc

title: Data Policy & Governance Lead
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

Data Primacy only holds if enterprise data can be verified, classified, and trusted across every downstream application and AI model. As Data Policy & Governance Lead within CX Platforms and Delivery Innovation, you will build and scale programmatic governance-as-code across Everpure’s enterprise data estate-running Everpure on Everpure-and translate those proven practices into scalable customer advisory. Partnering closely with Data Architecture, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Field Deployed Engineering, you will safeguard the integrity of customer, product, and operational data while accelerating AI adoption. Your work establishes the foundation of trust, verifiable compliance, and automated data policy that powers mission-critical CX workflows and customer AI initiatives globally.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Implement Governance-as-Code: Design and deploy automated policy, sensitivity classification, and access controls programmatically into data pipelines, replacing manual review boards with continuous, code-based verification.

• Embed Governance into Data Contracts: Partner with Data Architecture to codify ownership boundaries, lifecycle quality gates, and contextual entitlements directly within enforceable data contracts across core platforms including ServiceNow, CRM, and MDM.

• Preserve Verifiable Data Truth: Establish authoritative, single-record governance that prevents fragmentation and localized duplication as autonomous agents, data products, and analytics models scale across business units.

• Deliver High-Impact Customer Advisory: Partner with Field Deployed Engineering teams to translate validated internal frameworks into enterprise customer offerings, conducting maturity assessments, executive workshops, and best-practice advisory for AI-era data risk.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

• Demonstrated track record implementing hands-on data governance, data intelligence, and compliance programs within modern, cloud-scale data ecosystems.

• Hands-on proficiency with programmatic policy frameworks, automated entitlement enforcement, or policy-as-code tooling (such as Open Policy Agent, attribute-based access control, Unity Catalog, or modern enterprise metadata and catalog platforms).

• In-depth knowledge of global data privacy and regulatory structures (such as GDPR, CCPA) paired with practical understanding of emerging AI risk and governance frameworks (such as the NIST AI RMF).

• Proven advisory and communication skills, with the ability to lead executive and technical workshops, quantify governance value, and guide cross-functional legal, security, and data teams through complex risk decisions.

You will also troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, optimize performance, and develop automation solutions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving distributed systems challenges and improving the developer experience.

Location: Must reside in the Eastern Time Zone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Be a keen learner:

- At Temporal, you’ll work with cloud-native, highly scalable infrastructure spanning AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and microservices. You’ll gain deep expertise in container orchestration, networking, and observability while learning from complex, real-world customer use cases.

- Our stack includes Go, Python, and Java, providing continuous opportunities to hone your programming skills in infrastructure automation, resilience engineering, and performance tuning.

Be a passionate problem solver:

- If you enjoy tackling scalability, reliability, and troubleshooting challenges in distributed systems, you’ll thrive in this role. As a Senior Developer Success Engineer, you’ll work directly with developers to debug complex infrastructure issues, optimize cloud performance, and enhance reliability for Temporal users.

- You'll develop observability solutions (Grafana, Prometheus), improve networking (load balancing, DNS, ingress/egress), and automate infrastructure operations (Terraform, IaC) to help customers run Temporal efficiently at scale.

- Once ramped up, we expect you to independently drive technical solutions, whether debugging complex production issues or designing infrastructure best practices. Don't worry, we have seasoned engineers and mentors to support you along the way!

Be a great communicator:

- As a Senior Developer Success Engineer you will engage directly with developers, engineering teams, and product teams to understand infrastructure challenges and provide solutions that enhance scalability, performance, and reliability.

- Your insights will influence platform improvements, from enhancing observability tooling to developing self-service infrastructure solutions that simplify troubleshooting (e.g., building diagnostic tools similar to Twilio’s Network Test).

- You’ll serve as a bridge between developers and infrastructure, ensuring that reliability, performance, and developer experience remain top priorities as Temporal scales.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 6+ years of experience as a developer, preferably fluent in one or more of the following languages: Python, Java, Golang, TypeScript.

- Experience with deployment and managing medium to large-scale architectures (e.g., Kubernetes or Docker).

- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana and troubleshooting performance and availability issues.

- Minimum of one year experience in an internal or external customer-facing role.

- Passion for helping others regardless of who they are or how they act.

- Experience working with or as part of remote teams.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Seek to understand first, lead with data, and rely on facts.

NICE TO HAVE

- Previous experience in customer-facing positions such as a professional services consultant, solutions architect, customer engineer, etc.

- Experience with security certificate management and implementation.

- Ability to understand use cases and translate them into Temporal design decisions and architecture best practices.

- Technologies: EKS, GKE, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTracing, Terraform/Ansible/CDK.

title: AR Cash Application Specialist (Project job)
locationText: Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Serbia, Ukraine
description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable logistics and IT provider in the industry by offering and maintaining consistently high-quality services.
We are looking for a detail-oriented AR Cash Application Specialist to support our client's accounting team during a temporary high-volume project.
The primary focus of this role will be processing outstanding customer remittances, matching incoming payments to invoices, resolving payment discrepancies, and helping the accounting team clear an existing backlog.
This is a temporary, full-time opportunity for approximately 6-10 weeks, with the possibility of transitioning into a permanent position depending on business needs and performance.
Responsibilities and Duties:

• Review, process, and apply outstanding customer remittances to the appropriate customer accounts and invoices.

• Match incoming payments with corresponding invoices and ensure accurate payment allocation.

• Process high volumes of cash application transactions while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.

• Investigate unapplied, unidentified, and misallocated payments and work toward resolving discrepancies.

• Review remittance advice and supporting payment documentation to identify relevant invoice details.

• Reconcile payment records against customer accounts and bank transaction information.

• Identify short payments, overpayments, missing remittance information, and other payment discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal accounting and finance teams to obtain missing information and resolve outstanding payment issues.

• Maintain accurate records of processed transactions and outstanding exceptions.

• Monitor progress against the existing remittance backlog and help bring cash application activities up to date.

• Follow established accounting procedures and ensure all transactions are properly documented.

Requirements

• 1+ year of experience in Accounts Receivable, Cash Application, Billing, or a similar accounting role.

• Practical experience with cash application and payment posting.

• Understanding of accounts receivable processes, invoice matching, and payment reconciliation.

• Experience processing customer payments and reviewing remittance advice.

• Ability to identify and investigate unapplied or unidentified cash and payment discrepancies.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with accounting systems or ERP platforms.

• High attention to detail and accuracy when processing financial transactions.

• Ability to manage high volumes of repetitive tasks while maintaining productivity and quality.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.

• English proficiency sufficient for working with financial documentation and internal communication.

Will Be a Plus:

• Experience in US-based logistics companies or US accounting operations.

• Previous experience in logistics, transportation, or freight brokerage accounting.

• Familiarity with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or other accounting/ERP systems.

• Experience with bank reconciliation and customer account reconciliation.

• Knowledge of freight billing, customer payments, and remittance processing.

We Offer:

• Employment in an international company with opportunities for professional growth.

• Competitive compensation in USD.

• Full-time workload of 40 hours per week.

• Company-provided equipment.

• An opportunity to gain experience working with an international accounting team.

• Potential to transition into a permanent position based on business needs, performance, and available opportunities.

Working Conditions:

• Employment type: Temporary / Full-time.

• Project duration: Approximately 6-10 weeks.

• Working schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Work mode: To be confirmed.

- Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast.

- Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth.

- Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try.

- We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly.

description:
Role Summary

Revamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to lead engineering delivery for EPC clients building utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects. Every project you manage brings more clean power to the grid, and your leadership determines how smoothly it moves from design to construction. You will run several projects at once with full ownership of their outcomes, and clients and our engineering teams will rely on you for clear direction on scope and next steps. You will bring our civil, electrical, structural, and power systems engineers together around a shared plan and earn client confidence through sound judgment and transparent communication.

You will join a mission-driven team accelerating the energy transition, where collaboration and trust shape how we work with clients and with each other. As an employee-owner, you will share directly in the success of the firm and the projects you help deliver.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

• Own project scopes, schedules, and budgets from kickoff through closeout.

• Manage multiple smaller projects or several complex projects simultaneously.

• Coordinate and manage internal discipline teams and external subconsultants to ensure timely and accurate deliverables.

• Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing.

• Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts.

• Ensure projects comply with client requirements, contractual obligations, and Revamp quality standards.

• Prepare and review project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans.

• Review complete project documents for conformity, quality assurance, and contractual compliance.

• Apply standard project management procedures and criteria with independent judgment.

Client & Stakeholder Coordinations

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.

• Lead and participate in project meetings with clients, internal teams, and subcontractors.

• Present project status, risks, and key issues clearly and confidently to stakeholders.

• Review client standards, best practices, and project-specific requirements and ensure alignment across teams.

• Assist with proposal development, including scope definition, budgeting, and scheduling inputs.

Collaboration & Team Support

• Assign tasks to and direct discipline team members to complete project assignments.

• Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work in collaboration with technical leads.

• Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project and engineering staff.

• Support a collaborative, accountable, and transparent project team environment.

Additional Responsibilities

• Perform essential duties including meeting project deliverables and deadlines.

• Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field or an associate’s degree in a related field plus substantial relevant industry experience.

• Minimum 5+ years of project management experience in an engineering consulting environment, renewable energy, or similar industry.

• Demonstrated experience managing project scopes, schedules, budgets, and invoicing.

• Ability to independently evaluate, select, and apply standard project management procedures.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex project issues.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.

• Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Preferred

• Substantial experience in renewable energy engineering, development, or construction environments.

• Familiarity with the renewable energy project development lifecycle.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.

description:

Come join our Cloud Technology Group!
Akamai's Cloud Technology Group (CTG) takes ownership for designing, building, maintaining and operating our global Cloud and CDN platforms. We develop and deploy critical technologies that provide the technical underpinnings for all of Akamai's products. The CTO's team ensures consistent security, reliability and availability for our customers.
Partner with the best
You will lead the evolution of Akamai's cloud infrastructure and platform services by driving key initiatives across multiple engineering teams. In this role, you will design foundational solutions that directly power and support all of Akamai's future cloud products.
As a Principal Architect on the CTO's team of our global cloud platform, you will be responsible for:

• Identifying critical improvements for inclusion in the cloud platform roadmap

• Collaborating with solution-specific architects across engineering to define architectures that lead toward a unified cloud platform vision

• Socializing and building consensus around long-term technical strategy decisions across product lines and teams to advance our cloud platform vision

• Engaging with both external partners and stakeholders across the company to achieve our platform evolution goals

• Working with counterparts in engineering to ensure that our cloud platform architecture aligns well with other product goals

• Providing leadership through both high-level guidance and hands-on design as needed to execute against our cloud platform roadmap.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 12 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree or its equivalent

• Demonstrate extensive experience developing and documenting architectures for large-scale distributed systems

• Have solid experience with high availability software systems and methods for achieving service security, reliability and operability objectives

• Possess working knowledge of Internet protocols (routing, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, etc.) and computer security (TLS, PKI, VPN, etc.)

• Possess expertise in cloud workload management (for containers, VMs, etc.) and control plane paradigms (push, pull, segmentation, reconciliation, etc)

• Have an extensive understanding of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS with experience in one or more public cloud offerings

• Have experience modernizing and refactoring system designs to bring systems into alignment with enterprise-grade scalability, reliability, and observability

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. Our focus is simple:

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. The Multidiscipline Media Senior Associate plays a key role in driving e-commerce growth across LATAM by connecting brands with consumers through impactful digital campaigns.
